ICE_FORMAT.title: ICE is not valid
ICE_FORMAT.hint: An ICE has 15 digits and passes the mod-97 check. Usually a misread digit.

SUPPLIER_KNOWN.title: Supplier not found in Odoo
SUPPLIER_KNOWN.hint: No single Odoo supplier has this ICE. Check the ICE, or create the supplier in Odoo.

CUSTOMER_IS_US.title: Customer is not our company
CUSTOMER_IS_US.hint: The customer ICE on the document is not ours. Check the ICE or reject the document.

REQUIRED_PRESENT.title: Required value missing
REQUIRED_PRESENT.hint: A required value was not read. Type it from the document.

LINE_MATH.title: Line total does not add up
LINE_MATH.hint: Quantity × unit price differs from the line total. Usually one misread number.

SUM_HT.title: Lines do not add up to total HT
SUM_HT.hint: The sum of the line totals differs from the total excl. tax.

VAT_MATH.title: VAT breakdown does not add up
VAT_MATH.hint: A VAT base × rate differs from the VAT amount, or the bases differ from the line totals.

SUM_TTC.title: Total incl. tax does not add up
SUM_TTC.hint: Total HT + VAT differs from the total TTC.

LOW_CONFIDENCE.title: Low extraction confidence
LOW_CONFIDENCE.hint: The extractor was unsure about a required value. Check it against the document.

PO_NOT_FOUND.title: Purchase order not found
PO_NOT_FOUND.hint: No confirmed Odoo PO with this reference. Check the PO reference on the document.

PO_SUPPLIER_MISMATCH.title: PO belongs to another supplier
PO_SUPPLIER_MISMATCH.hint: The PO found in Odoo is for a different supplier than the invoice.

BL_MISSING.title: Delivery note missing
BL_MISSING.hint: A three-way match needs the delivery note. Wait for it or reject.

LINE_UNMATCHED.title: Line not on the purchase order
LINE_UNMATCHED.hint: This line could not be paired with a PO line by reference or description.

QTY_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED.title: Billed more than received
QTY_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED.hint: The supplier bills goods Odoo has not received. Reject and ask for a credit note, or validate a further receipt in Odoo first.

QTY_BL_MISMATCH.title: Delivery note disagrees with the receipt
QTY_BL_MISMATCH.hint: The BL quantity differs from what Odoo received. Check the BL; approve with a reason if the receipt in Odoo is right.

PRICE_OVER_TOLERANCE.title: Price differs from the PO
PRICE_OVER_TOLERANCE.hint: The unit price is outside the tolerance. Approve with a reason if the new price was agreed, otherwise reject.

BILL_TOTAL_MISMATCH.title: Odoo totals differ from the invoice
BILL_TOTAL_MISMATCH.hint: The draft Odoo computed did not match the invoice totals, so it was not kept.
